expected.title: Uniform integrability of truncated continuum-polymer partition functions for positive-jump Lévy noise with finite large-jump first moment and dimension-dependent small-jump moments
expected.author: Quentin Berger; Hubert Lacoin
expected.difficulty_reason: Standard positive-martingale convergence does not provide L1 convergence when the unrestricted second moment can diverge. The authors construct good-trajectory truncations and control intersecting Poisson replicas by stochastic comparisons and dimension-dependent multibody energy constraints. The resulting summable simplex bounds make the truncation error uniformly small and close uniform integrability in every printed dimension case.
